card.name: Letters and digits inside drug names and doses
card.fires_on: Short pieces in the middle of a name, number or phrase, such as 'la' in Spanish 'bajo la lengua', or a letter inside a brand name like ORKAMBI or ENJAYMO. It also fires on digits and separators in section numbers and dose strings.
